source: an ERP system-agent call recorded on a test deployment of the demo data (its per-batch rows and its grand total, as the call's own result printed them)
sql: SELECT si.batch_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.company_name, SUM(si.quantity_shipped) as total_quantity, SUM(si.quantity_shipped * p.list_price) as total_value FROM shipment_items si JOIN shipments s ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON si.product_id = p.product_id WHERE si.batch_id IN ('RUN-20261031-92001', 'RUN-20261101-90001', 'RUN-20261101-92004', 'RUN-20261102-91002', 'RUN-20261102-91005') GROUP BY si.batch_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.company_name ORDER BY si.batch_id, c.customer_code
